stem.text: A uniform beam rests on two supports, X and Y, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal beam resting on two supports labelled X (left) and Y (right), with a person standing on the beam. Downward arrows labelled 700 N and 200 N act on the beam. Distances marked from support X: 6.0 m to the person's position, 10.0 m to the 200 N arrow and 20.0 m to support Y. Note: not to scale.

stem.text: The beam has length $20.0\,\text{m}$ and weight $200\,\text{N}$.
A man of weight $700\,\text{N}$ stands on the beam at a distance of $6.0\,\text{m}$ from support X.
What is the contact force of support X on the beam?
